note: Phase 2A FINAL commercial configuration. Values are either (a) an APPROVED business rule supplied by the business, or (b) extracted from data/catalog.json with provenance, or (c) null and BLOCKING. Nothing is invented. Where a rule exists but its values were never supplied, the record is present with null values and status NOT_CONFIGURED so the engine blocks explicitly.

procurement.note: DECISION CLOSED (P2-J): allocation is by purchase-value proportion, supplier->warehouse only. Project transportation is NEVER allocated in here. PROCUREMENT DATA STATUS (updated 2026-09-05): 5 SEED batches present (BATCH-SEED-001 through BATCH-SEED-005). 257 procurement records carry landedUnitCost (100% coverage). 112/257 records have delivery allocation applied (landedUnitCost != purchasePrice); 145/257 have landedUnitCost == purchasePrice — Procurement must confirm intent (delivery absorbed vs allocation gap). All 5 batches are SEED, not PRODUCTION. Production issuance requires a non-seed batch (locked 2.8). cost engine no longer blocks on LANDED_COST_NOT_CONFIGURED for these 257 records; production quotation issuance still requires production procurement data.

componentLevelSellingPrice.reason: Decision C74 — V1 has ONE pricing methodology, at project level.

dataStatus.note: Per locked 2.8: seed data preserved; production issuance requires a non-seed batch

roofAddOn.note: flat-roof structure material is emitted as BOM lines

installation.source: catalog.installationMatrix, used at src/App.jsx:2113 as an absolute project amount
installation.unitEvidence: The matrix value is used directly, never multiplied by kW. 3 kW FLAT = 15000 and 10 kW FLAT = 42000 is not a common per-kW rate. PER_PROJECT is established by the source. Confirmation by the business remains open item P2-H.

removedLegacyFallback.note: The per-kW legacy fallback is no longer reachable. Decision C75: a missing exact size/type combination returns INSTALLATION_COST_NOT_CONFIGURED and blocks. The nearest system size is never used.

siteSurvey.note: The 500 is ALL-INCLUSIVE — no separate engineer travel is ever added, and project transportation is a different cost head. The 100 km threshold is an approved business rule and is never silently changed. The 3/km excess rate is Project Head configuration on the rate card and may be revised there, with full audit history.

engineeringDesign.source: APPROVED business rule: 500 per project up to 20 kW, all-inclusive.
engineeringDesign.note: DECISION CLOSED (P2-L): above 20 kW the Project Head RATE CARD band ">20kW" determines the rate, with its own unit. The 500 is NEVER extrapolated and never computed per kW unless a band record explicitly declares PER_KW. VALUE NOT YET CONFIGURED: no >20kW rate supplied, so projects over 20 kW block with ENGINEERING_DESIGN_NOT_CONFIGURED.

vehicles.changeReason: UAT reference rate (locked 2.1 formula). Historical/reference value only — NOT a production rate. isDemo:true.
UAT reference rate (locked 2.1 formula). Historical/reference value only — NOT a production rate. isDemo:true.

transportation.note: DECISION CLOSED (P2-M / locked 2.1): warehouse->site, ONE WAY, distanceKm x vehicle.ratePerKm. No round trip. No free-100km. No universal per-km rate (C76). The vehicles here are VERSIONED UAT REFERENCE rates flagged isDemo:true (2026-09-07 §16/§24): the Cost Engine may use them when productionMode=false; in PRODUCTION_MODE the commercial freeze REFUSES issuance unless the applied transport rate came from the PROJECT_HEAD versioned rate card (PUT /api/workspace/commercial/rate-card, rateType TRANSPORT_VEHICLE_RATE -> data/project-rate-card.json). The snapshot freezes vehicleType, distanceKm, ratePerKm, rateVersion, rateSource.

rejectedLegacyRates.reason: Decision C76 — no universal per-km rate. Rates are per vehicle type.
Second conflicting legacy rate, never read by the legacy engine.
The legacy free-distance allowance is not part of the approved model: TRANSPORTATION_COST = distanceKm x ratePerKm.

serviceAmc.source: APPROVED business values supplied 2026-08-16, under decision C9.
serviceAmc.businessMeaning: 2000 per year, 2 planned service visits per year, 5-year internal service period. BREAKDOWN HANDLING IS INCLUDED in this figure — there is no separate breakdown cost head.

annualEquivalentMetadata.note: Retained to explain the business meaning. The engine's authoritative calculation is costPerVisit x visitsPerYear x serviceYears; no annual-rate path exists in code.

serviceAmc.note: Above 10 kW returns SERVICE_OUT_OF_COVERAGE and is never extrapolated. All values are Project Head controlled and versioned on the rate card.
serviceAmc.customerPriceNote: Internal service cost and any customer-facing AMC selling price are different concepts, separately owned, never merged.

rejectedLegacyFallback.reason: The legacy engine fell back to 5500 when expectedProjectsPerMonth <= 0. That hides a misconfiguration; the engine now returns OFFICE_ALLOCATION_INVALID.

miscellaneous.label: CONFIGURED MISCELLANEOUS ALLOWANCE
miscellaneous.source: APPROVED business rule supplied 2026-08-15: V1 default 1% of direct project cost before miscellaneous.
miscellaneous.note: An explicit COST ALLOWANCE, not hidden margin. Never computed from the selling price, so no circular dependency exists. Admin may change it, including to 0%. The legacy fixed Rs 1000 (catalog.costs.miscellaneous) is superseded.

margin.note: CONFIGURED 2026-08-29: 20% gross margin for all tiers. minimumMarginPct 15% as a guard rail. These are configuration values changeable by ADMIN role. Values approved by business owner.

gst.derivation: 0.70 x 5 + 0.30 x 18 = 3.5 + 5.4 = 8.9. The effective rate is an OUTPUT and a cross-check, never the calculation input.

marketRate.note: Benchmark only. It never replaces TOTAL_ACTUAL_PROJECT_COST and never becomes the customer selling price. Phase 0 found two configurations quoted below cost through marketRate (ongrid 3kW Value -11.1%, ongrid 5kW 1P Premium -41.9%); that failure is covered by regression tests.

specialProjectWorks.note: Special works are added explicitly per project by the Project Head with an actual amount. Predefined rates MAY be held on the rate card (rateType SPECIAL_WORK) but none has been supplied, so none exists. A work added without an amount returns SPECIAL_WORK_INVALID; no rate is invented.

netMeter.decision: The net meter is supplied/purchased by the CUSTOMER as required by KSEB. It is not a Flarize procurement item.
netMeter.display: May be shown as a separate CUSTOMER_SIDE_EXPENSE reference only.
netMeter.markup: NONE — Flarize never marks it up.
netMeter.note: Supersedes the earlier treatment of net metering as a Flarize CUSTOMER_EXTRA. There is no net-meter procurement price and no net-meter margin model. The deferred net-meter price master is moot: Flarize does not sell it.
